description.en: The ID of the IPv4 gateway.

description.zh:
要查询的IPv4网关实例的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the IPv4 gateway.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**100**，默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query and no next queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call.

description.zh:
要查询的IPv4网关列表信息的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the IPv4 gateways to be queried are deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the resource group to which the IPv4 gateway belongs.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key. You can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The key cannot exceed 64 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The key must start with a letter but cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value. You can specify at most 20 tag values. It can be an empty string.

The tag value cannot exceed 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 要查询的IPv4网关实例关联的VPC的ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) with which the IPv4 gateway is associated.

title.zh: 查询IPv4网关实例的列表信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc list-ipv4-gateways --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --vpc-id vpc-5tsrxlw7dv074gci40000 --ipv4-gateway-id ipv4gw-5tsnc6s4ogsedtp3k0000 --ipv4-gateway-name name --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc ListIpv4Gateways --region cn-hangzhou --Ipv4GatewayName name --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --VpcId 'vpc-5tsrxlw7dv074gci40000' --Ipv4GatewayId 'ipv4gw-5tsnc6s4ogsedtp3k0000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --MaxResults 10 --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
